DESPITE THE CHALLENGES AND DANGERS HE FACES, NASHAT IS DETERMINED TO UNCOVER THE RICHES BURIED BENEATH AL-KHARTOOSHI'S HOUSE IN THE AL-KHALIFA NEIGHBORHOOD. programme.title: قبل الضو
